children: ExxonMobil Holdings will repurchase all outstanding XTO Energy senior notes totaling $426.819 million on Sept. 27, 2026.
XTO issued redemption notices to call all 2036, 2037 and 2038 senior notes for full redemption on Sept. 27, 2026.
$174,435,000 of 6.10% notes due 2036 and $252,384,000 of 6.75% notes due 2037 are outstanding.
Redemption Price = 100% of principal plus the Make-Whole Amount and accrued interest to the Redemption Date.
Payment via DTC for book-entry holders; certificated holders must surrender notes to the paying agent to collect proceeds.
